messages:
anjali_cs: Heads-up: TideWork (TW-92) onboarding — they need APAC peering (SG PoP), a temporary throughput bump to 160 QPS for 14 days, and header allowlist for X-Client-ID/X-TW-Signature. Renewal flagged ~60d out; want this in the pilot window. Can infra/network provision CIDR peering + rate window?
ryan_sre: we have spare capacity in the sg cluster for a short bump. i'll coordinate autoscale and canary routing. need the CIDRs and whether LB-level header allowlist is fine.
kevin_net: can you paste the CIDRs and desired start time? also need customer ASN/peering key for the peering ticket.
anjali_cs: customer sent CIDRs and details:
```
{
  "cidrs": ["203.0.113.0/28", "198.51.100.128/25"],
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps": 160,
  "duration_days": 14,
  "allow_headers": ["X-Client-ID", "X-TW-Signature"],
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```
requested start: 2026-03-29T08:00:00Z (customer local morning). Renewal contact: marta_success.
kevin_net: got it. i'll open a peering change request, need ASN and peering key though.
anjali_cs: ASN 64512, peering key "tide-2026" (from customer). They explicitly asked header allowlist at the gateway/edge level rather than app-level.
ryan_sre: gateway header rule is doable. i'll add an edge policy that accepts those headers and rejects others for that token. i'll tag the change with expiry+auto-revoke after 14 days. estimate cost delta ~ $1,500/month; prorated for 14 days ~ ~$700. finance confirmation required.
marta_success: noted — i will confirm cost with the customer and get sign-off. tagging renewal owner and linking to renewal runbook. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Ticket INC-4129 created for TW-92: "APAC peering + 160 QPS temporary rate bump + header allowlist". Change window: 2026-03-29T08:00Z, expiry: 2026-04-12T08:00Z. Config id cfg-8892.
kevin_net: scheduling peering work with network team for 02:30 PDT before the change window. i'll post peering BGP session details once up.
ryan_sre: pushed staging config cfg-8892 to staging. monitoring hooks added (latency >300ms or error rate >2% will alert infra-oncall). fallback routes set to model-small if we hit capacity pressure.
marta_success: customer approved the cost and agreed to the start time, gave verbal ok for the pilot SLA. i sent the signed pilot addendum.
anjali_cs: great — please proceed. reminder: auto-revoke must be enforced and enrichment for renewal pipeline updated. i'll close onboarding checklist after prod confirmation.
ops-bot: Change promoted to prod at 2026-03-29T08:00Z — peering up, rate window active, header allowlist applied.
ryan_sre: monitoring green on first 30m, p50 latency unchanged, p95 +30ms, error <0.5%. will keep an eye.
kevin_net: BGP session stable, ASN 64512 peer up, advertised prefixes accepted.
anjali_cs: thanks team — posting to customer that onboarding is complete and tagging renewal owner @marta_success. please leave final notes here for the runbook.
